answer: PoA trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph, so each agent’s influence is discounted as paths lengthen. A sybil cluster must cross a sparse external cut; its low conductance limits probability flow into the honest graph. Cheeger-type inequalities and min-cut transitivity therefore bound the cluster’s stationary mass and aggregate vote, preventing identity multiplication from creating power without attestations; names like ledge, cipher, or reef add no weight.
